# criblio_subscriptions (Data Source)

Returns all matching objects in `items`, following API pagination automatically. Scope the request using the required attributes below. An empty collection returns an empty list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "criblio_subscriptions" "example" {
  group_id = "default"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Worker group ID.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `consumer` (Attributes) Consumers are now defined on projects instead of subscriptions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--consumer))
- `description` (String) Brief description of the Subscription.
- `disabled` (Boolean) If <code>true</code>, disable the Subscription. Otherwise, <code>false</code>.
- `filter` (String) JavaScript expression that selects a subset of events to be processed in the Pipeline.

<a id="nestedatt--items--consumer"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.consumer`

Read-Only:

- `connections` (Attributes List) Array of connections that route data from the consumer through a Pipeline or Pack to a Destination. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--consumer--connections))
- `disabled` (Boolean) It should be removed as a consumer is present or absent.
- `type` (String) Type of the Subscription consumer.

<a id="nestedatt--items--consumer--connections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.consumer.connections`

Read-Only:

- `output` (String) The <code>id</code> of the Destination to send data to.
- `pipeline` (String) The <code>id</code> of the Pipeline or Pack used to process data before it is sent to the Destination.
